rationale: Version 5 carries every value of version 4 and changes one selector: po_box_cedex also reads invented-postal-guideline (issue #2764), evaluation-only rows that write a DE Postfach, an IT casella postale and the AU CARE PO, MS and RMS delivery types as the operators' cited guidelines state them, on places the corpus split holds out. Version 4 read only invented-po-box-cedex, which covers US, FR, CA, AU and NZ, so DE and IT had no row in the capability and AU had none for those three types. The recipe refuses a row whose split is not test. No candidate result had been examined under version 4; no confirmation read is recorded.

requirements.reason: Shipped en-us graph: rooftop geocoding, the demo default, postcode-us.bin and pair-index-us.bin. Exact parse of house number, street with the corpus affix split, locality, region and ZIP on three rows in five.
Shipped fr-fr overlay: rooftop geocoding over BAN and the lieu-dit pair index. Number, street, postcode and locality exact on nine rows in ten.
Shipped en-gb overlay: postcode-gb.bin, the GB pair index and county-as-region rows. Number, street, locality and postcode exact on four rows in five.
Shipped de-de overlay with the Ortsteil pair index. Street, number, PLZ and locality exact in either order on seventeen rows in twenty.
Shipped en-in overlay with the area-line pair index. Area line, locality and PIN exact on half the OSM-style rows.
Shipped es-es overlay with a pair index; tier-2 claim. Register rows exact on four in five.
Shipped it-it overlay with a pair index; tier-2 claim. Register rows exact on four in five.
Shipped en-au overlay, GNAF-trained; tier-2 claim. Register rows exact on four in five.
Shipped en-nz overlay with the LINZ pair index. Register rows exact on four in five.

inference.description: HELDOUT_INFERENCE_RULE in heldout/per/country.ts (served-locale-package): each row is parsed by the shipped Latin locale package for its country (release.config.json locales), falling back to en-us, with the row's country as localeHint; a package whose loader reports an unfed required channel is refused. The verdict records the rule and the rows each package parsed.

statistics.groupingAssumption: A row's independent unit is its group within its country: base_source_id when derived, else source_id. Rows are not declared independent, so a check that reads an ungrouped row is insufficient evidence. Limitation: structure shared across groups (one source's conventions, one place's many addresses) is not modelled. The dataset quota counts groups, not rows, against 1,000 per country.

development.description: Unregistered: freeze heldout-<corpus>-dev with one seed; used for recipe, checkpoint and seed selection.

confirmation.description: Unregistered: freeze heldout-<corpus>-confirm with a disjoint seed; read only for the release decision, every read recorded in the next spec version's rationale.
